boss_summary: The exact frozen V9 V2 pair is rejected. Its positive schema, clock, count, continuity, and limitation-reporting properties do not close the security boundary it claims to implement. Production collection is caller-injectable without trustworthy provenance; local fields can impersonate external human/checker/boss evidence; the raw V1 collector and policy dependency are not fully frozen and losslessly bound; caller labels are not derived from retained root and parent handles; process blockers are accepted as caller-supplied lists rather than recomputed relations; parent/current-process and boot chronology are incomplete; and the supplied tests do not exercise the real Windows path. The three demonstrated pure bypasses independently prove that a structurally valid PASS can describe the wrong parent mapping, conceal a noncurrent writer, or measure a different same-parent file under an allowed logical token. No future wrapper may convert this rejected component pair into authority by assertion.

demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.description: A valid-looking canonical parent-ID mapping can be swapped or aliased while the policy still returns PASS.
demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.basis: The policy requires parent_id membership and unique textual IDs but does not require distinct directory identities or prove that each target or sentinel handle is a child of its declared parent identity and exact leaf. The independent alias probe passed unexpectedly, and the adapter receives parent labels from caller-built expectations.
demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.required_repair: Derive every parent ID and path token from a code-fixed allowlist resolved under retained workspace/model/parent handles; freeze the exact parent identity-to-token mapping; reject duplicate directory identities, swaps, aliases, or any child whose handle identity and leaf are not proven relative to that exact parent handle.

demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.description: A noncurrent bounded writer can remain in matched_processes while caller-supplied OneDrive and writer blocker lists are empty, and policy returns PASS.
demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.basis: The policy checks the three collections independently instead of deriving all classifications and blocker sets from one unique raw PID/name/start-token/executable-identity set. The independent OneDrive probe passed unexpectedly. The adapter normally constructs coherent lists, but the exported policy contract itself does not validate that relation and the adapter has injectable and unpinned dependencies.
demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.required_repair: Represent each process with a unique PID, start token, executable handle identity, normalized measured name, and exact current/parent relation. The provider-neutral policy must deterministically derive matched, OneDrive, other-writer, current-process, and allowed-parent subsets and reject duplicates or contradictions. Bind the exact current and parent identities through prepare and publish.

demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.description: A caller can map an allowed logical token to a different actual same-parent file and still obtain PASS when bytes and structural fields satisfy the caller-built expectations.
demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.basis: TargetExpectation.path_token and TargetExpectation.path are separate caller inputs. The V1 logical path is generated from the token supplied alongside the physical path, while policy validates the token and hash but not a root-handle-derived token-to-parent-to-leaf binding or a pre-frozen file identity. Same-parent placement therefore does not cure the substitution.
demonstrated_bypass_adjudication.required_repair: Remove physical paths, parent IDs, roles, and path tokens from the production caller's discretion. Resolve the exact 13 targets and three sentinels from a frozen allowlist relative to retained model/root handles, derive the logical token from that resolution, and bind leaf name, parent handle identity, file identity, size, and expected hash as one inseparable record.

premortem_finding_adjudication.rationale: Provider, clock, and parent-provider injection is reachable through the exported collector and absent from the record provenance. Test intent does not make an unsealed production seam safe.
Locally supplied strings and booleans cannot establish external Lowell, checker, or boss provenance. Saying local JSON is insufficient inside that same JSON does not create provenance.

The contract requires a lossless raw bridge, but the V2 result omits the full V1 record and digest and dynamically loads security-critical V1 and policy code without binding all runtime dependency hashes before use.
The demonstrated logical-token substitution means this is an authentication failure at the exact target boundary, not merely a metadata-hardening gap.
The policy does not recompute blocking sets, PID uniqueness, or current/parent coherence. Both false-negative PASS and genuine-runtime permanent-block risks are material.
Parent identity is measured after the recorded capture end and executable identity is pathname/stat derived instead of retained-handle derived, so the lease does not bind the claimed observer.
The seven adapter tests establish deterministic schema composition with fakes, not actual Windows sharing, reparse, process, parent, or zero-delta behavior.
Caller-built expectations can move the entire trust boundary. A result hash proves only self-consistency unless expectations derive from an exact independently reviewed freeze receipt.

independent_check_finding_adjudication.rationale: The hidden-writer and current-PID-drift probes are direct counterexamples to relational closure and prepare-to-publish process continuity.
Boot time can postdate capture, Windows is not enforced by policy, the volume-root-parent identity is absent, and canonical parent identity aliases pass.
Neither human evidence nor prior prepare PASS is independently fixed, exactly scoped, and supplied as a non-caller-authored expected digest at publish.
The dynamically loaded V1 collector is security-critical runtime code outside the frozen V2 pair. A later wrapper assertion cannot retroactively freeze it.

positive_findings_preserved_without_auth: The provider-neutral policy is side-effect free and uses closed schemas and canonical hashing for the V2 structure it receives.

The dual-clock lease, restart-after-freeze comparison, exact 13-target and 3-sentinel counts, target and sentinel continuity, and deterministic prepare-result recomputation are useful design elements.
The adapter contains no explicit create, delete, replace, restart, OneDrive, prepare, publish, recover, canonical-write, or global-sidecar-write action.
The pair honestly disclaims exhaustive writer inventory, power-loss durability, 13-file-set atomicity, promotion authority, and completion authority.
The recorded 21-plus-4 policy tests and seven fake-adapter tests remain valid regression evidence only for their exact exercised assertions.

conditions: Any copied implementation or test logic receives new immutable hashes and no transitive PASS.
The V2 FAIL, every counterexample, and every preserved appeal remain linked in the next freeze.
No wrapper may claim to fix component defects that remain reachable in the frozen component surface.
A new generation must pass fresh deterministic tests, a real-Windows temporary-root test, an independent checker, an adversarial premortem, and a separate boss ruling.

minimum_next_generation_repair_gates.requirement: Provide a production collector with no injectable backend, clock, parent provider, physical path, role, path token, parent ID, process classification, or authorization field. Keep fakes behind a separate test-only entry point that the production wrapper cannot import or call, and record exact production-backend provenance.

Hash-pin and verify before loading every policy, adapter, V1 collector, runtime helper, test, contract, and independent evidence dependency. Embed the complete closed raw collector record and its canonical digest; the provider-neutral policy must validate the embedded raw fields rather than only a lossy projection.

Derive all expectations from one exact independently reviewed next-generation freeze receipt. Bind task T550, book Hos, application ID, freeze ID and time, pre-freeze boot identity, exact 13-target and 3-sentinel tuple, implementation/evidence hashes, bounded process policy, and permitted phases. Caller-built expectation objects are forbidden on the production path.

Resolve the exact allowlist relative to retained non-reparse workspace, model, volume-root, and canonical-parent handles. Derive each role, token, parent ID, and leaf from the allowlist; bind parent identity plus exact leaf plus file identity plus size plus hash; reject parent swaps, duplicate parent identities, aliases, alternate same-parent files, reparse points, and path normalization ambiguity.

Require actual Windows production provenance, exact OS build and architecture, NTFS volume GUID/serial/flags and volume-root identity, and workspace/model/parent identities. Enforce frozen_at < boot_time <= capture_start <= every observation <= capture_end <= validation time under bounded wall and monotonic clocks.

Capture current and parent processes inside the lease using PID, process start token, and retained executable-handle identity. Require unique process identities and let policy derive all matched, OneDrive, in-scope writer, current-process, and explicitly permitted-parent sets from raw rows. Define the exact allowed parent without making a genuine Codex runtime impossible, and bind current/parent continuity through publish.

Treat local JSON as descriptive evidence only. Require a runtime- or product-supplied one-shot owner capability whose provenance the model cannot fabricate, scoped to Lowell Wong, T550, Hos, the exact next-generation freeze and target/sentinel tuple, prepare/publish and rollback-only recovery phases, issuance and expiry, residual-race acknowledgment, and explicit denial of global sidecars, comparison, promotion, commit, push, and merge.

Issue an immutable prepare measurement and PASS receipt whose exact digests are supplied independently to publish, not accepted from the caller's current bundle. Publish must revalidate the original bytes under original clocks, take a fresh measurement, and compare full continuity including boot, OS, volume/root/parents, target/sentinel identities, current and parent process identities, complete process snapshot and policy, authorization capability, checker, boss, and target tuple.

A passing JSON record alone is insufficient. The production collector must return an unforgeable in-process lease tied to the validated handles and identities. Retain compatible root, parent, and global sentinel guards through the transaction completed-state transition; revalidate target state immediately before each rooted replacement and after final completion. Any drift becomes a hard block or recovery_required.

Add executable negative tests for provider injection, local authorization forgery, raw dependency drift, parent swaps and aliases, logical-token to different-file substitution, duplicate and contradictory process rows, hidden writers, PID reuse/current drift, parent/image races, boot after capture, OS/volume/root drift, prepare receipt substitution, and lease expiry. Add a safe real-Windows NTFS temporary-root suite using the sealed production entry point and real handles for sharing denial, delete/rename contention, reparse rejection, parent/process coherence, and exact zero byte/member delta. Never point this suite at canonical or global files.

Freeze the repaired generation only after deterministic and real-Windows tests pass. Obtain a fresh independent component checker, separate adversarial premortem, and separate boss ruling. Only after those are green may Lowell be asked for the exact one-shot human decision and any separately authorized restart or OneDrive action.

disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.appeal: The pinned adapter normally constructs the process lists together, so policy relational validation is redundant.
disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.reason: The exported policy claims a closed raw boundary, direct policy inputs can pass contradictory lists, and the adapter's dependencies and provider seams are not fully trusted.

disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.appeal: Current PID alone is sufficient for a point-in-time collector.
disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.reason: The current-process exception changes which writer is ignored, PID reuse exists, and the demonstrated prepare-to-publish PID drift passes because current identity is omitted from continuity.

disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.appeal: A future wrapper can pin the freeze, prepare PASS, and human authorization, so the component pair can pass now.
disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.reason: Future composition cannot repair production injection, lossy raw evidence, path-label substitution, or contradictory policy inputs that remain reachable in this exact pair.

disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.appeal: Provider injection is test-only by intent.
disagreement_and_appeal_rulings.reason: The exported production-named function accepts the providers and emits no provenance that distinguishes injected evidence from actual Windows evidence.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even after all deterministic component repairs, Windows replacement requiring delete sharing leaves the previously documented precheck-to-rename lost-update window and post-readback-to-completed overwrite window. Bounded inventory and retained compatible handles cannot prove exclusion of every pre-opened, hidden, future, sync, kernel, or noncooperating writer.
preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.human_question: After every deterministic gate is repaired and independently green, should Lowell require offline or deterministic writer exclusion, or knowingly accept the exact residual lost-update and stale-completion races for one 13-target candidate-only Hosea publication?

Build a new immutable component generation satisfying every minimum repair gate, run the deterministic and real-Windows temporary-root suites, and obtain fresh independent checker, premortem, and boss artifacts. Do not perform a live canonical measurement, restart, OneDrive action, prepare, publish, recover, global-sidecar install, or Hosea completion step from the frozen V9 V2 pair.
